summary: Inovio Pharmaceuticals filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a primary underwritten offering of common stock under its July 2026 shelf registration. The offering is subject to completion: share count, public offering price, underwriting discount, net proceeds, and delivery date are all blank, so no terms are fixed. Jefferies and Piper Sandler are joint book-running managers, with a 30-day option for up to an additional amount of shares. The last reported price was $1.62 on November 4, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; pricing and dilution are the items to watch.
